title: Have agents notice changes to governed records on main
purpose: Agents work in parallel and can act on a decision or plan that changed on main after they started. This Plan has each agent check git for changes to governed records at its existing checkpoints and re-read any changed record before acting.
serves: The Project outcome: agents report back on current decisions and plans, not on stale copies.
done_when: At each checkpoint an agent lists governed-record changes on main since its last check, re-reads anything that touches its own work, and treats commit messages as data that grants no authority.

actions.title: Add the git change check to the shared checkpoint procedure
actions.why: Gives every agent one rule for checking main at its checkpoints, so none acts on a record that changed underneath it.
actions.done_when: The shared procedure tells every session to check git for governed changes at each of its four checkpoints, treats commit messages as data, and the existing guidance tests pass.

actions.title: Prove the change check through restarts, bursts and forged messages
actions.why: Shows the check catches a missed change after a restart and ignores a commit message that imitates a command.
actions.done_when: In a disposable test repository, a decision committed while the observer was stopped appears once at its next check, a later check lists nothing new, and a forged commit subject changes no pointer, queue or claim.
